fieldData.acrm---key-feature-1-content:
Partners answer about each other

Each partner answers every question twice: once for themselves, once guessing the other. The app counts every guess that lands on the partner's own answer and scores it out of 12.
fieldData.awb---key-feature-1-content:
Who knows whom best: the Brandts, 11 of 12

Priya Okonjo and Tomas Novak invited 4 couples to game night and sent out one link. Each partner answered 12 questions about the other, and a guess that matched the partner's own answer scored 1 point. The final board put Leah and Sam Brandt first at 11 of 12 and June and Ravi Chandran last at 6 of 12.

fieldData.acrm---key-feature-4-content:
Alerts the moment a quiz is finished

Send a Slack message or an email on every finish: the packer learns which roast to bag, the trainer reads the score the same morning. You choose who hears about which result.
